title: HOLD Rules Record
description: Schema for every record in rules/*.yaml. citation and quote are required; a record missing either is UNVERIFIABLE and excluded from all claims.

id.description: Unique rule id, snake_case. Example: GA_300_7_1_03_school_night_curfew

jurisdiction.description: Primary jurisdiction this rule applies to. NY, IL, LA and NM carry trust records only (params.kind: trust).

authority.description: Issuing body. Example: Georgia Department of Labor

citation.description: Exact legal citation. Example: Ga. Comp. R. & Regs. 300-7-1-.03(2)(a)

title.description: Short human-readable rule name shown in the verdict card.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence from the statute or handbook. Required; record is UNVERIFIABLE without it.

source_url.description: Deep link to the source document.

valid_from.description: ISO date from which this record is effective. Inclusive.

valid_to.description: ISO date after which this record is no longer effective. Null = indefinitely valid.

params.description: Rule-specific numeric parameters keyed by name. Example: {max_work_hours: 5, curfew_school_night: '22:00'}. kind: trust marks a display fact that the checker and the solver never read.

verified.description: VERIFIED: quote confirmed against source snapshot in rules/sources/. UNVERIFIABLE: source not accessible. PENDING: not yet checked.

note.description: Optional free-text note for unusual interpretation or caveats.
